C0953.title: 700+ Forged ID Cards Lead to Conviction
C0953.summary: Jiangxi Political and Legal Network reported on August 7, 2024, that a court issued a verdict in a case involving the forgery of over 700 resident identity cards. The perpetrator was held criminally liable under Article 280, Paragraph 3 of the Criminal Law for forging identity documents.

references.title: Over 700 Forged ID Cards: Sentenced! - Court - Jiangxi Political and Legal Affairs Network
